verdict.rationale: Rive documents open-source runtime APIs (web, mobile, game engines) for loading and controlling animations programmatically (rive-docs-21, rive-gh-1, rive-docs-14/15), plus a text-based file format (RML) explicitly designed for coding agents and automated workflows (rive-docs-13, 20, 25, 30), and an official MCP server/AI agent integration for driving the Editor via AI tools (rive-docs-19, 27, rive-probe-4, rive-docs-9/18). Together these give an AI-native user multiple documented, agent-friendly ways to control the product beyond the GUI. Missing for 10: a formal REST/OpenAPI-style public API (probe shows 404s for openapi/swagger endpoints) and independent third-party corroboration of programmatic API usage.
